inputs.text: Look at the mess progressive mismanagement has brought us to. Instead of focusing on the basics of education, discipline, and fiscal common sense, our public systems are collapsing under the weight of bloated bureaucracies and misplaced priorities. Now we see a parent in the South Portland School District having to step up and publicly apologize to the educators and staff over a massive budget shortfall that is going to slash over 70 positions from our schools. This is what happens when traditional values and accountable governance are tossed aside in favor of endless spending and administrative bloat. Our children and hardworking taxpayers are left to pay the price for these recurring budget crises, while the core mission of education gets gutted. It is time to restore order, demand personal responsibility from local leaders, and stop treating our schools as slush funds for failed progressive agendas.
